brief:
Taqwa Ahmed Alwawi describes the emergence of a writing community in Gaza, according to ArabLit. The initiative grew beyond initial workshop sessions as writers sought connection and creative expression amid the conflict. Members used their work to document experiences and sustain cultural life under wartime conditions.

The community developed as writers sought isolation and the need for shared purpose among Gaza's literary practitioners. Participants gathered to exchange work, offer feedback, and maintain literary practice despite severe restrictions on movement and resources. The group continued to meet and operate throughout the period covered in the account.
dek: Taqwa Ahmed Alwawi explores the creation of a community of writers in Gaza under genocide.
title: Gaza writers form community despite ongoing genocide
